title: Self-Pay Visit Package Payment Options: Installments and Accepted Cards
content:
**Payment options by tier — Self-Pay Visit Package.** Only the larger tiers may be paid in installments; every tier accepts HSA and FSA cards.

| Tier | Installments allowed | Number of installments | Days between installment due dates | Days after a due date before an unpaid installment freezes visit crediting | Card kept on file for automatic drafts | HSA or FSA card accepted |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Starter 4-Visit Package | No | 1 | 0 | 0 | No | Yes |
| Recovery 6-Visit Package | No | 1 | 0 | 0 | No | Yes |
| Core 8-Visit Package | No | 1 | 0 | 0 | No | Yes |
| Complete 12-Visit Package | Yes | 2 | 30 | 10 | Yes | Yes |
| Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package | Yes | 3 | 30 | 10 | Yes | Yes |
| Comprehensive 24-Visit Package | Yes | 3 | 30 | 10 | Yes | Yes |

**How the columns are defined**

- *Number of installments* — the number of equal installments when the package is paid in installments; 1 where installments are not allowed.
- *Days between due dates* — calendar days between installment due dates; 0 where installments are not allowed.
- *Late days* — calendar days after an installment due date after which an unpaid installment freezes visit crediting; 0 where installments are not allowed.
- *Card on file* — whether a card must be kept on file to draft later installments automatically on their due dates.
- *HSA or FSA card accepted* — whether HSA or FSA cards are accepted for package payments.

**Hypothetical reading.** A Post-Surgical 18-Visit Package bought in installments is paid in 3 installments whose due dates are 30 calendar days apart, with a card kept on file; an installment left unpaid more than 10 calendar days after its due date stops further crediting. A Core 8-Visit Package is paid as a single payment in full.
